SAFETY DATA SHEET
Karrawong Building Products (fictional example)
Date of issue: 2021-08-09
Version 5

SECTION 1: Identification
Products covered by this SDS:
FinishCoat Plaster Light (code KP-101)
FinishCoat Plaster Standard (code KP-102)
FinishCoat Plaster Quick (code KP-103)
FinishCoat Plaster Base (code KP-104)
Recommended use: Interior wall plastering.
Emergency telephone: +61 2 5550 0199

SECTION 2: Hazards identification
Classified as hazardous according to the model WHS Regulations.
Skin irritation Category 2; Serious eye damage Category 1.
Signal word: Danger
Hazard statements: H315 Causes skin irritation. H318 Causes serious eye damage.
Precautionary statements: P280 Wear protective gloves/eye protection. P305+P351+P338 IF IN EYES: rinse cautiously.
Not classified as dangerous goods.

SECTION 3: Composition
Calcium sulfate hemihydrate 26499-65-0 60-100 %
Calcium hydroxide 1305-62-0 1-5 %

SECTION 7: Handling and storage
Keep dry. Avoid dust generation.

SECTION 8: Exposure controls
Use in well ventilated areas. Wear a P2 dust mask, safety glasses and gloves.

SECTION 9: Physical and chemical properties
Appearance: white powder.

SECTION 14: Transport information
Not regulated for transport. UN number: not applicable. Hazchem: not applicable.
